```ts
import type { Plugin, PluginContext } from "../../kernel/types";

export const manifest = {
  apiVersion: 2,
  permissions: {
    capabilities: [
      { kind: "service", id: "pricing" },
      { kind: "tool", name: "quote_total" },
    ],
  },
};

const plugin: Plugin = {
  id: "pricing",
  name: "Pricing",
  version: "1.0.0",
  onLoad(ctx: PluginContext) {
    ctx.register({
      kind: "service",
      id: "pricing",
      value: {
        total(n: number) { return n * 21; },
      },
    });
    ctx.register({
      kind: "tool",
      tool: {
        name: "quote_total",
        version: "1.0.0",
        description: "...",
        permissions: [],
        sideEffect: "none",
        parameters: {...},
        outputSchema: {...},
        async handler(args, tctx) {
          const svc = ctx.inject("service:pricing").value;
          return { ok: true, data: { total: svc.total(args.n) } };
        },
      },
    });
  },
};
export default plugin;
```
